changelog:
Initial release of project-memory-workflow

- Adds onboarding workflow for creating and maintaining AI-readable project memory in software repositories.
- Detects project context, existing conventions, and documentation before initialization.
- Initializes minimal project memory files on explicit user request, ensuring existing user changes and repository conventions are preserved.
- Adopts OpenAI/Codex (AGENTS.md) and Claude (CLAUDE.md) instruction file conventions, maintaining compatibility where needed.
- Requires agents to use project memory for context, decision tracking, and risk management throughout development tasks.
- Implements practices to keep documentation trustworthy, concise, and free from sensitive information.
summary: A cross-agent project memory skill for Codex and Claude Code, enabling consistent context, documentation, and development history across sessions.
